title: Design: long and special names in the price details and Parts tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with tier A on Markup % 20.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a long name with spaces that no other record of that kind has, at least 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Plan), on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>), on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with part A added.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at part A's sell price.
  3. Click the Parts tab.
  4. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  5. Click Change Customer.
  6. Pick customer B.
  7. Click Update Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The popover shows tier A's and customer A's names inside its own box, wrapped if needed; no text runs past the popover's edge.
  • Every row of the popover stays visible.

Step 3:

  • Part A's Priced By shows tier A's name inside its own cell; the Margin column stays visible beside it.
  • The page does not scroll sideways.

Step 4:

  • The menu lists Change Customer.

Step 5:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 6:

  • Customer B's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included, inside the Customer field.
  • The amber note's text stays inside the dialog.

Step 7:

  • The notice shows tier A's name inside the notice bar, wrapped if needed.
  • The work order's lines stay visible below it.
